name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 28 times in 8 visits over 34 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 29 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.78 to 2.35 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
